provenance.author: AUD-08 smallest slices (Claude)
provenance.notes: Smallest expressible partial-exit slice: real partial fills need the AUD-08 event trace (the v1 trace is one row per position), but a partial that floors to zero produces no partial fill, so its correct outcome is one row. AUD-02 C25 (accepted rule, both legacy models implement it): a PARTIAL take-profit whose quantity floors to 0 at the step sends nothing and marks nothing done (no breakeven, no tp1 flag); the level is evaluated again later. Step 5: qty 10 / 2 = 5 (one step), tp1 = 0.5 x 5 = 2.5 -> 0. Candle 281 (green) reaches tp1 = 1 R = 102.02 at its leg end: nothing happens. Candle 282 (green, low 101.9 > the 98.02 stop) reaches the 2 R target 104.02 at its leg end: the whole 5 close at 104.02 x 0.9998 = 103.999196; pnl = 5 x (103.999196 - 100.02) - 5 x (100.02 + 103.999196) x 0.0005 = 19.385932, R = 1.9385932. Deterministic: no seed.
